items.reason: apps/web/components/dialog/AddGuestsDialog.tsx:43-44 passes arbitrary server messages through translation and constructs an always-nonempty string, so unknown messages appear in the toast and the generic fallback never runs. packages/trpc/server/middlewares/captureErrorsMiddleware.ts:15 applies redactError, but packages/lib/redactError.ts:23-27 sanitizes only selected Prisma errors in production and returns other errors unchanged.
